locations: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: game backgrounds contact sheet, SIX equal landscape panels, strict 2 columns x 3 rows, each panel 3:2, whole image 2:3, ideally 3072x3072. Painterly detailed anime fantasy JRPG matching sunlit cream stone Mediterranean town, terracotta tiles, green hills, warm natural colors. No lettering, captions, borders, characters in foreground or UI. Each panel self-contained, clean straight divisions. All views reserve lower 40% for overlaid text; upper center room for separate character sprites. Row 1 left: small comfortable prison annex in guard barracks, evening amber window light, wooden bunk along left wall, blanket, small wooden table center, barred door at right; no torture or dungeon. Row 1 right: accessible broad terracotta roof in sunny Tantrum, clay chimney at center right and roof tiles at center left, clean city roofs and green hills beyond, eye level just above roof, space for two workers on top, blue sky. Row 2 left: welcoming medieval pharmacy interior, wood shelves of herb jars and tied green sanка herb bundles, counter across center-right, visitor foreground left clear. Row 2 right: doorway of modest hunter's home near west gate, white rabbit hides piled behind a small workbench to right, narrow cobbled lane, empty center left for client and visitors. Row 3 left: late-afternoon modest Tantrum market, clothing and cheap weapon stalls, folded simple brown trousers, plain jacket and wool cap, redbearded merchant's wood counter at right, central walkway clear; no readable signs. Row 3 right: sunny peaceful cobbled city street of cream stucco houses with terracotta roofs and blue banners, smiling small background families only, western city gate visible deep in background, empty center foreground for two workers. This is a coherent six-background resource atlas for chapter 3, never a finished UI.
hero: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: TRANSPARENT sprite sheet, strict 4 columns x 2 rows, exactly eight equal cells, entire canvas landscape 2:1, each cell square. Match the black hair with white streaks, small tied ponytail, face and athletic adult man of the first visible reference; he now wears plain white shirt, brown waistcoat, sturdy brown trousers, belt, heavy simple brown shoes. Painterly anime JRPG watercolor and fine ink contours. Consistent character identity, clothing, body size, lighting. Full body completely inside each cell, clear transparent margin 8%; standing feet at same baseline, constant body proportions, sitting pose does not become giant. No ground, no backdrop, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. Row1 left to right: 0 ashamed standing head down empty hands facing slightly right; 1 alert stance facing right holding rough wooden club in right hand; 2 winds up same club with right arm overhead to hit enemy on right; 3 low forward club strike to the RIGHT, torso bent naturally, feet fixed; Row2: 4 recoils clutching chest after horn blow, no blood; 5 sits crosslegged eating red apple, body scale same; 6 crouches reaching down to replace a roof tile, no roof drawn, clay tile in hands; 7 stands examining crude handmade iron knife in right hand, subtly pleased. Absolutely real alpha transparent background, not a painted checkerboard. Props never extend outside cell. Sheet should be 2048x1024 or larger same ratio.
authorities: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: six cells transparent sprite atlas, strict 3 columns x 2 rows, landscape 3:2, full figures, equal square cells, no borders/text/background. Painterly fantasy anime JRPG matching silver plated guards with green scarves of second reference. Row1 all same imposing two-meter elderly guard captain Oma Tobuyama, thick enormous grey mustache, broad beaked nose, grey bushy eyebrows, silver heavy plate, dark green surcoat, no helmet, full boots, face aimed LEFT toward hero: 0 furiously lecturing hands on hips; 1 startled grimace bending slightly with one gauntlet clutching his backside through armor, reacts sympathetically to painful cedulis juice; 2 softened smiling compassionate expression, one open hand offering reprieve. Row2: 3 TWO supporting guards matching the reference Osama black beard and Hatiko grey beard, both wincing and synchronously reaching behind to their backsides through armor, spears held safely, both full bodies within their one cell (smaller than captain fine, will scale separately); 4 elderly thin stooped craftsman Kudja, grey hair, wrinkled kindly face, simple beige tunic and brown work apron, nails between lips, holds paintbrush in right hand, tool belt, full figure facing LEFT; 5 same craftsman offers a rough wooden club with right hand toward LEFT, other hand rests at hip. Same captain and craftsman body sizes across their poses, feet share baseline within cells; 8% transparent margins, genuine alpha transparency, no checkerboard or floor. Warm directional sunlight, finely drawn faces.
merchants: Use case: illustration-story. Asset transparent sprite sheet FOUR equal cells in 2 columns x 2 rows. Painterly anime medieval JRPG, warm soft sunlight, fine ink contours, full bodies, natural faces, feet baseline same, no text, no background, no counter, no cell border. Cell0 attractive friendly mature woman apothecary in modest sage-green dress and beige apron, gentle smile, holds tied medicinal herb bundle in her left hand; cell1 elderly wrinkled hunter Satsubaki Sujiro with one slightly wandering eye, grey short hair, simple worn brown leather hunting vest and trousers, right hand raised in teaching/blessing gesture toward LEFT, kind patient expression, no weapon; cell2 large sturdy ginger-bearded merchant proud broad grin, crossed arms, brown linen tunic with sleeves rolled up, simple belt and trousers, facing LEFT; cell3 merchant's son a SHORT young ginger-haired teenage boy, practical plain brown tunic trousers, right hand extending crude handmade iron knife safely hilt first toward LEFT, face serious businesslike, no aggression. Everyone wholly contained in cell with transparent margins, preserve relative adult vs boy scale; genuine alpha transparent background, no checkerboard.
items: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset genuine TRANSPARENT inventory item atlas, strict 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal square cells, landscape 2:1, 2048x1024. Finely detailed painterly fantasy JRPG item art, warm soft top-left light, same perspective and readable large silhouettes, no text, no numbers, no slot frames, no decorative UI. 12% transparent margins each cell, no inter-cell overlap. Ordered row-major items: row1 cell0 rough short wooden club fashioned from knotty branch, simple blunt wood only, diagonal lower-left to upper-right; cell1 crude handmade knife with short uneven iron blade and plain wrapped wood hilt, diagonal same, not a fine dagger; cell2 folded plain white shirt with brown waistcoat and brown belt over sturdy brown trousers, heavy simple shoes beside them as one equipment bundle; cell3 prison food ration: large bowl of meat stew and few bread and cheese slices grouped neatly, appetizing, no tray border; row2 cell4 small bowl of simple soup for 10 canis; cell5 folded plain brown beginner trousers only; cell6 simple utilitarian brown beginner jacket, no armor or ornaments; cell7 simple plain brown wool cap. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard. These assets shared by chapter 3 and future chapters; do not include meat loot or rabbit hides.
